title: chat-server: Space/set create does not make the creator an administering member
description: handle_space_set create (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs ~line 1041) builds the Space with empty roles and members. Draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (cefc217) §Creating a Space: 'The server assigns the Space's id and adds the caller to members with at least one role granting permissions sufficient to administer the Space. The specific bootstrap-role configuration is server-defined; servers MAY pre-create a high-position role for the caller, MAY assign every permission from {{space-permissions}}, ...'. Since JMAP-yt1w.33 the Space permission gates always resolve against the owner's member entry (accountId), so a Space created over the wire cannot be administered at all. This makes 4 jmap-testjig tests in crate-jmap-testjig/tests/chat_client_wire.rs fail with forbidden: space_add_categories_moves_channel_into_new_category, space_add_roles_round_trips_each_color_representation, space_join_rejects_banned_caller, space_join_unknown_or_private_space_is_not_permitted. Needs a decision on the bootstrap-role configuration (role id/name/position/permission set). chat-server tests currently work around it with tests/common grant_owner_admin.
notes:
Mark decision 2026-10-19: Space/set create (handler, all backends) pre-creates one SpaceRole {name "Admin", permissions = every permission in draft §space-permissions, position = 9007199254740991 (2^53-1, max JMAP UnsignedInt)} and adds the caller's member entry {id: accountId, roleIds: [that role]}. No new trait hook. Draft basis: cefc217 §Creating a Space 'adds the caller to members with at least one role granting permissions sufficient to administer the Space'.
Implemented (uncommitted): handle_space_set create builds Space with roles=[{id "admin", name "Admin", permissions = SPEC_PERMISSION_NAMES, position 9007199254740991}], members=[{id accountId, roleIds ["admin"], joinedAt now}], memberCount 1. SPEC_PERMISSION_NAMES gained the missing "start_call" (draft cefc217 SpaceRole permissions). Removed the .33 test workaround grant_owner_admin (would have duplicated the owner member entry); integration.rs gets clear_members fixture for 3 Space/join success tests (owner is now a member; setup only, assertions unchanged) and ban_caller restored to the HEAD SpaceBan/set form. integration.rs carries both .33 and .34 hunks, so .33/.34 file sets are not disjoint: one combined commit. Gates: fmt, clippy --workspace --tests, cargo test --workspace, jmap-testjig (4 chat_client_wire tests now pass), rustdoc -D warnings all pass. --all-features chat_set_duplicate_direct_cleanup failure is pre-existing (JMAP-v8y0).
Done in 90a18713: tests space_create_adds_creator_as_member_with_admin_role, space_create_creator_can_administer_new_space, space_create_creator_member_entry_is_account_id_not_principal, space_create_bootstrap_role_is_max_position_admin_with_every_permission; changed existing tests: space_join_public_space_success, space_join_via_invite_code_success, space_join_expired_ban_does_not_block, ban_caller helper (used by space_join_*_banned_forbidden, space_join_expired_ban_does_not_block, space_join_argument_check_precedes_ban_check), space_set_update_role_member_variants_dispatch_to_backend (doc comment only), make_space / grant_owner_admin fixture (affects every make_space user, message_broadcast_permission.rs create_channel, message_mention_arrays.rs create_channel)
